entities.name: SHOX (O15266)
observations: Human SHOX; the query sequence is an exact 100% full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt O15266.
Sequence length is 292 aa; calculated molecular mass is approximately 32.2 kDa and theoretical pI is 7.23.
Curated function: homeobox transcription factor controlling fundamental aspects of growth; directly activates NPPB transcription in osteogenic cells.
Binds sequence-specific DNA, preferentially recognizing 5'-TAATNNNATTA-3'; may form homodimers.
Curated localization is nucleus, including nucleoplasm and chromatin.
Associated biological roles include regulation of RNA polymerase II transcription and skeletal system development.

entities.name: SHOX homeodomain
observations: Pfam Homeodomain PF00046 detected at residues 118-174 with i-Evalue 1.5e-24.
The homeodomain supports sequence-specific DNA binding and transcription-factor activity.

entities.name: SHOX OAR domain
observations: Pfam OAR PF03826 detected at residues 271-288 with i-Evalue 2.8e-07.
The C-terminal OAR region is characteristic of SHOX-family homeobox proteins; its specific mechanistic contribution is not established by this sequence analysis.

entities.name: NPPB
observations: NPPB is a curated direct transcriptional target of human SHOX in osteogenic cells.

entities.name: Skeletal system development
observations: Human SHOX is annotated to skeletal system development and growth regulation.
